# Cigna Corp Deep Dive Analysis

Report 078 | Published 2022-02-20 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2022-2-20/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/078.json)

Cigna value accompanies crypto infrastructure analysis.

Gold records and the local inflation turning point are confirmed. Brazil and China diverged, so emerging markets cannot be scored as one call. The report corrects Ethereum withdrawal timing. Terra discussion contains a serious fragility blind spot alongside explicit warnings and tiny research-only holdings. Cigna operating progress is separate from its five-year investment outcome.

**Coverage:** All article text blocks were read. Ledger covers material macro, investment, and causal propositions; incidental descriptive statistics, boilerplate, and unreasoned position lists are excluded. Image labels were read, not image pixels.

## Framework lessons

- Separate custody from the underlying protocol.
- Evaluate per-share growth and policy channels.

## Verification limitations

- Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
- Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
- Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
- Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
